topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out the building isn't staying a rental—it's turning into condos. Immediate thoughts? Well, the walls didn’t whisper this little tidbit, did they? All these years, I thought I knew my home’s story, but turns out, it’s got a surprising twist. Guess I'll have to rethink the long-term vacancy of my living room. Coffee tastes a bit different this morning, doesn’t it? A change of plans is brewing, and it seems I'm on the menu.
